label: Controls for rational exercise by universal causes and its applications
paraphrase: Two actual beings in two mutually accessible worlds. The universal cause has intellect, will and a rational power. Each omission of the esse-giving adapter, classified exercise, natural priority, or firstness keeps the other three and falsifies universal rational exercise. With firstness and a fixed non-rational exercise the priority rule fails. An alternative fixed rational exercise satisfies all four and the rational conclusion while end direction, recipient-directed willing and the NarDerivation fixity-to-required-means rule with an empty requirement relation fail.
